title: 第9章 偷盗工具第10章 偷盗成功
content_zh:
;;
深夜，窝棚鼾声如雷。
陈平攥紧玉佩。
嗡。
脚踏实地。头顶微光照旧。
他第一时间看向那片新播种的土地。
一千个小土包，依旧安静。
但仔细看去，一些土包的表面，已经有了细微的松动迹象，仿佛下面有东西在轻轻拱动。
陈平蹲下身，凑近其中一个松动明显的土包，屏息凝视。
一点微弱的、透明的嫩白，顶开了一小粒黑土，探出了头。
不是一株，而是好几株。
细如发丝，脆弱，但它们确实冒出来了。在一个坑里。
陈平的心一跳。
成了。出苗了。
而且，一个坑里撒六粒种子，真的能出好几棵苗。
按照他的经验，水稻种子种下，到出苗的时间，一般是十天到十五天。
而玉佩空间中的黑土地，只用了一天，就抽出灵稻苗。
这是否意味着，黑土地能以普通灵田十倍的速度，生长灵植？
陈平压下激动。他还需要观察，才能验证这一结论。
又去看旁边的土包。

果然，不少土包表面都有了松动的痕迹，有些已经能看到不止一点嫩白破土。
虽然只是刚刚冒头，离成熟还远，但这景象让陈平振奋。
他小心地绕着这片新生的苗床走了一圈，确认没有发现枯萎，才带着踏实退了出去。
接下来的时间，陈平白天忍受着苦役，精神却集中。
他观察着周围的一切。
尤其是和农事有关的东西。
他需要工具。
收割六千株灵谷，用手去拔？用那根硬木棍去撬？太慢，效率太低。
他需要镰刀。
收割下来的稻穗，需要脱粒。
用手一粒粒去搓？六千株？那得搓到何时？
他需要脱谷的工具。
他见过凡俗农人用的木制脱谷车，一个带齿的木轮子，摇动手柄，稻穗放进去，谷粒就被打下来。
宗门里管理普通灵田的杂役处，肯定有类似的东西，而且更大，更结实。
脱下来的谷粒，还带着谷壳。
需要去除谷壳才能得到能吃的灵米。这需要风车和石磨。

Late at night, there was thunderous snoring in the shack.
Chen Ping clutched the jade pendant tightly.
Buzz.
down to earth. The glimmer of light above the head is old.
He immediately looked at the newly sown land.
A thousand little bumpkins are still quiet.
But if you look closely, you can see that there are slight signs of loosening on the surface of some earth bags, as if something is gently arching underneath.
Chen Ping squatted down, approached one of the loose earth bags, and held his breath.
A faint, transparent white light pushed through a small grain of black soil and poked its head out.
Not one, but several.
Hair-thin and fragile, but they do pop up. In a pit.
Chen Ping's heart skipped a beat.
It’s done. Seedlings have emerged.
Moreover, if you scatter six seeds in a hole, you can really produce several seedlings.
According to his experience, the time from planting rice seeds to seedlings usually takes ten to fifteen days.
It only took one day to extract the spiritual rice seedlings from the black soil in the Jade Pendant Space.
Does this mean that black soil can grow spiritual plants ten times as fast as ordinary spiritual fields?
Chen Ping suppressed his excitement. He still needs to observe to verify this conclusion.
Then he looked at the dirt bag next to him.
Sure enough, there were signs of looseness on the surface of many earth bags, and more than a little bit of tender white soil could be seen in some.
Although he has just emerged and is far from mature, this scene makes Chen Ping excited.
He carefully walked around the new seedbed to confirm that no wilting was found, and then retreated with confidence.
In the following time, Chen Ping endured hard labor during the day, but he was focused.
He observed everything around him.
Especially things related to farming.
He needs tools.
Harvest six thousand spiritual grains and pull them out with your hands? Use that hardwood stick to pry? Too slow and too inefficient.
He needs a scythe.
The harvested rice ears need to be threshed.
Rub them one by one with your hands? Six thousand plants? How long will it last?
He needs threshing tools.
He had seen the wooden threshing cart used by ordinary farmers, with a wooden wheel with teeth. When the handle was shaken, the ears of rice were put in, and the grains were knocked out.
The miscellaneous office that manages ordinary spiritual fields in the sect must have something similar, and it is bigger and stronger.
The grains that are taken off still have the chaff.
The chaff needs to be removed to obtain edible spiritual rice. This required windmills and stone mills.
